ui.name: Nebraska Department of Labor, Unemployment Insurance

efile.text: An employer who is filing more than 50 Forms W-2, W-2G, 1099-R, 1099-MISC, and/or 1099-NEC with Nebraska income tax withholding amounts for a tax year must file the forms electronically.

epay.text: Most taxpayers required to make monthly withholding deposits have been mandated to submit their payments via EFT.

deposits.interpretation: Nebraska: 'The amount of income taxes withheld determines the frequency of deposits.' For the first month of a quarter a deposit is required if more than $500 was withheld in that month; for the second month a deposit is required if more than $500 was withheld in either the second month or the first. Deposits are due by the 15th of the month following the month the tax was withheld. INTERPRETATION: the circular does not state what happens to month 3 or to months at or under $500; they are treated as paid with the quarterly Form 941N, due the last day of the month after the quarter (the quarterly return is stated to be filed whether or not any tax was withheld). 'In either this period or in the first month' is read as: month 2 is deposited when month 2 exceeds $500 OR month 1 exceeded $500. Employers licensed as annual filers file one Form 941N for the calendar year, due January 31 of the following year.

returns.name: Form 941N, Nebraska Income Tax Withholding Return
contents: Filed whether or not any payments subject to Nebraska withholding were made during the quarter, unless licensed as an annual filer.
Due on or before the last day of the month following the end of the quarter.
May be e-filed using DOR's free Form 941N filing program.

returns.name: Form W-3N, Nebraska Reconciliation of Income Tax Withheld
contents: Due on or before January 31 of the following year; filed separately from Form 941N.
Nebraska copies of Forms W-2, W-2G and the specified 1099s are due January 31 after the close of the tax year.
